div.head: I Cn 6.1
div.ab: ⁊ ealle Godes þeowas we biddað ⁊ lærað ⁊ huruþinga sacerdas, þæt hi Gode hyran ⁊ clænnesse lufian ⁊ beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes yrre ⁊ wið ðone weallendan brýne, þe weallað on helle.
And ealle Godes þeowas we byddað ⁊ lærað ⁊ huruðinga sacerdas, þæt hig Gode hiran ⁊ clænnissa lufian ⁊ beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes irre ⁊ wið þonne weallendan bryne, þe wealleð on helle.
And ealle Godes þeowas we biddað ⁊ lǽrað ⁊ huruþinga sacerdas, þæt hi Gode hiran ⁊ clænnesse lufian ⁊ beorgan him silfum wið Godes irre ⁊ wið ðone weallendan bryne, þe wealleð on helle.
et ei digne seruiant et castitatem diligant,
⁊ ealle Godes þeowas we biddað ⁊ lærað ⁊ huruþinga sacerdas, þæt hi Gode hyran ⁊ clænnesse lufian ⁊ beorgan heom sylfum wið Godes yrre ⁊ wið ðone weallendan brýne þe weallað on helle.
And we pray and enjoin all the servants of God, and priests above all, to obey God and practice celibacy and guard themselves from the wrath of God and from the raging fire which blazes in hell.

Und alle Gottesdiener bitten und weisen wir an, und vor allen Dingen Priester, dass sie Gott gehorchen und Keuschheit pflegen und sich selbst vor Gottes Zorne hüten und vor dem wallenden Feuer, das wallt in der Hölle.
And we ask and instruct all servants of God, and above all priests, to obey God and love chastity, and guard themselves against God's anger and against the surging fire that surges in hell.
div.note: A's ‘beorgum’ should be corrected to ‘beorgan’. D's ‘⁊ hi’ should be ‘þæt hi’. Liebermann compares VI Atr 5.
